mapper.sql: select be.execution_id as "executionId", be.batch_id as "batchId", bd.batch_type as "batchType", be.execution_status as "executionStatus", be.process_type as "processType", be.reason as "reason", be.operator_user_id as "operatorUserId", coalesce(kps.name, u.login_id, cast(be.operator_user_id as varchar)) as "operatorName", be.original_execution_id as "originalExecutionId", be.request_id as "requestId", be.created_at as "createdAt", be.updated_at as "updatedAt", coalesce(be.execution_parameter_json::text, '{}') as "executionParameterJson" from batch_executions be join batch_definitions bd on bd.batch_id = be.batch_id left join users u on u.user_id = be.operator_user_id left join korus_personnel_snapshots kps on kps.employee_no = u.employee_no
mapper.select: order by be.updated_at desc, be.execution_id desc limit #{limit} offset #{offset}
select count(*) from batch_definitions where batch_id = #{batchId}
mapper.insert: insert into batch_executions (execution_id, batch_id, process_type, reason, operator_user_id, execution_status, original_execution_id, request_id, execution_parameter_json) values (#{row.executionId}, #{row.batchId}, #{row.processType}, #{row.reason}, #{row.operatorUserId}, #{row.executionStatus}, #{row.originalExecutionId}, #{row.requestId}, CAST(#{row.executionParameterJson} AS jsonb))
mapper.update: update batch_executions set execution_status = 'STOPPED', process_type = 'STOP', reason = #{reason}, operator_user_id = #{operatorUserId}, request_id = #{requestId}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP where execution_id = #{executionId} and execution_status = 'RUNNING'
